messages:
sam (AM): Lantana Health asks for a 2-week POC next Monday. Goal: validate summarization model fit. They want 7B-int4 for cost + 70B-fp16 for fallback. Also procurement needs EU residency and weights isolation confirmation.

rosa (ml eng): Put the HF id here and I'll run a compat pass. Expect int4 to need runtime support; many custom ops float around.

sam (AM): HF id: hf.co/lantana/clinic-summarizer-v3. Avg seq ~400, peaks ~1500.

ben (infra): We can host 7B-int4 on dedicated; int4 path may fallback to generic kernels with perf hit. 70B will be hosted in eu-west-1.

rosa (ml eng): Quick scan: tokenizer OK. INT4 export includes a fused matmul unsupported by our int4 kernels -> CPU fallback for that op, ~25% latency penalty on those paths. FP16 looks clean. Command I ran: `./compat-check --model hf://lantana/clinic-summarizer-v3 --quant int4,fp16`.

kevin (solutions): Customer needs latency SLOs for integration tests. Can we get 512/1024 numbers by EOD? Also will draft security answers for weights and residency.

tara (sales-eng): Procurement prefers a simple POC price: hosted tokens -20% first billing + first 48h infra waived. Can ops accept? :money_with_wings:

ben (infra): -20% fine. Reserving a 3-node 7B pool in eu-west-1 now. Note: sustained high load >2 weeks will require commit.

rosa (ml eng): Local perf (single replica, batch=1): 7B-int4 (with fallback): 400 -> 85ms avg, 1500 -> 320ms avg. 70B-hosted: 400 -> 380ms avg, 1500 -> 1.2s avg. Scheduling a 12h run overnight and will upload CSV.

kevin (solutions): Security draft: "Weights encrypted at rest (AES-256), keys in KMS; Dedicated pools store model files on isolated volumes; for Private we support HSM and VPC control plane." Will post full doc to #sales-docs.

ops-bot: Job queued: reserve-dedicated-lantana (id: job-2026-03-21-77).

sam (AM): Action items: (1) rosa: 12h perf + CSV + short eval, (2) kevin: security answers + SOW region pinning, (3) tara: procurement blurb + SOW pricing, (4) ben: confirm instance types and capacity. Need all by EOD to sign SOW tomorrow.

rosa (ml eng): Uploaded perf CSV: hf://artifacts/lantana/perf/1875022222.csv. Will follow up if fallback cost skews numbers.

ben (infra): Confirmed: dedicated pool = 3x g5.12x equivalents, est throughput ~4.5k tokens/s, region pinned eu-west-1.

sam (AM): Thanks team. Ping me for urgent blockers. :thumbsup:
